Class NetworkCouplingReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.network.NetworkCouplingReport
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class NetworkCouplingReport extends Object implements Serializable
Convergence diagnostics for coupled hydraulic, composition, and thermal network calculations.

  • Constructor Details

    • NetworkCouplingReport

      public NetworkCouplingReport(boolean converged, boolean hydraulicConverged, int outerIterations, double maxFlowResidualKgS, double maxPressureResidualPa, double maxTemperatureResidualK, NetworkCompositionConvergenceReport compositionReport, String message)
      Create a coupling report.
      Parameters:
      converged - true when hydraulic and outer coupling criteria are met
      hydraulicConverged - true when the inner hydraulic solve converged
      outerIterations - number of hydraulic-property outer iterations
      maxFlowResidualKgS - maximum edge flow change in kg/s
      maxPressureResidualPa - maximum node pressure change in Pa
      maxTemperatureResidualK - maximum node mixing temperature change in K
      compositionReport - most recent composition convergence report
      message - diagnostic summary
